n_1fa58d2c2dae937c.name: Comment on the Jira issue
n_1fa58d2c2dae937c.source: export default async function comment({key,text},context) {return await context.actions.call('jira.add_comment',{issueIdOrKey:key,body:{type:'doc',version:1,content:[{type:'paragraph',content:[{type:'text',text}]}]}});}

n_66ae3bff6d2a9126.name: Link the Zendesk ticket
n_66ae3bff6d2a9126.source: export default async function update({ticketId,fieldId,issue},context) {if(typeof issue?.key!=='string'||!issue.key)throw Error('Created Jira issue has no key');return await context.actions.call('zendesk.update_ticket',{ticketId,customFields:[{id:fieldId,value:issue.key}]});}
